title: Mitchell TTX · counterair sweep
subtitle: 2024 exercise: three-axis CCA probes, fighter follow-on, between-pulse pressure
description: Source-based presentation of the sweep team's 2024 CCA tabletop exercise. Figures 4-5 show three expendable CCA approach axes, a fifth-generation fighter follow-on along one axis, and CCA/F-15EX pressure between maritime strike pulses.
assumptions: Figure 4 shows a 3:1 ratio of air-to-air weapon CCA to EW CCA across three conceptual axes.
Figure 5 uses recoverable CCA-1 screens, ISR CCA and standoff F-15EX between strike pulses.
Published TTX concepts and aggregate exercise results are sourced; the report does not disclose verified aircraft waypoints or flyable mission tracks.
Map positions, path geometry, animation duration and actor icons are deliberately schematic; presentation seconds are not elapsed operational hours.
Display actor counts are illustrative and must not be mistaken for the TTX's full force inventories or actual sortie totals.
